fields.name: date
fields.type: string yyyy-mm-dd (only month and day used; year ignored for next-occurrence)

filtersOrSort: client sort ascending by daysUntil(date) (next occurrence); grouped by month label
reads.note: Account.dates[] in 'fw-account'. daysUntil/dayMonth computed client-side from device date.

actions.name: addDate
actions.note: DateForm requires name.trim() and date. Toast '<name> is added.'

actions.name: removeDate
actions.note: Toast Undo re-adds the same row with the same id (re-create with client id).

actions.name: makeWishForDate
actions.note: Link to /app/new?for=&what=; navigation only, no server call.

special.note: Screen promises reminders 'a week before, and again the day before'; no code sends them: server timed work required. Reminder channel unspecified.

uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: account === undefined (useAccount before first effect); page returns null, no skeleton drawn
uiStatesHandled.note: localStorage read is synchronous; `known` module cache makes it undefined only on first mount. Renders null, not a skeleton.

stubsObserved.evidence: We remind you a week before, and again the day before.
